items.source: This implementation calls setValuesIfAvailable(PreparedStatement, int) and sets this instance's exhaustion flag accordingly.
items.translation: 此实现调用setValuesIfAvailable(PreparedStatement, int)，并相应地设置此实例的耗尽标志。

items.source: i - index of the statement we're issuing in the batch, starting from 0
items.translation: - 我们在批处理中发出的语句的索引，从 0 开始

items.source: Abstract implementation of the InterruptibleBatchPreparedStatementSetter interface, combining the check for available values and setting of those into a single callback method setValuesIfAvailable(PreparedStatement, int).
items.translation: `InterruptibleBatchPreparedStatementSetter` 接口的抽象实现，将检查可用值和设置这些值的操作合并为单个回调方法setValuesIfAvailable(PreparedStatement, int)。

items.source: This implementation returns Integer.MAX_VALUE. Can be overridden in subclasses to lower the maximum batch size.
items.translation: 此实现返回 `Integer.MAX_VALUE`。可在子类中重写以降低最大批处理大小。

items.source: Check for available values and set them on the given PreparedStatement. If no values are available anymore, return false.
items.translation: 检查可用值并将它们设置到给定的 PreparedStatement 上。如果不再有任何可用值，则返回 `false`。

items.source: This implementation return this instance's current exhaustion flag.
items.translation: 此实现返回该实例当前的耗尽标志。
`isBatchExhausted` 在接口 `InterruptibleBatchPreparedStatementSetter` 中

items.source: SQLException - if an SQLException is encountered (i.e. there is no need to catch SQLException)
